questions.qtext: The pole-zero map of rational function G(s) is shown below. When the closed contour is mapped into the G(s)-plane, then the mapping encircles

options.text: The origin of the G(s)-plane once in the clockwise direction.
The point –1 + j0 of the G(s)-plane two times in the counter clockwise direction.
The origin of the G(s)-plane two times in the counter clockwise direction.
The origin of the G(s)-plane two times in the clockwise direction.

questions.solution:
(d)
The given s-plane contour is encircling 4-poles and 2-zeros in anticlockwise direction, hence the corresponding G(s) plane contour encircles origin 4-times in clockwise direction and 2-times in anticlockwise direction.
∴ Effectively 2 times in clockwise direction.
